mapper.select: select count(case when r.purchase_kind = #{purchaseKind} then 1 end) as n_cash, coalesce(sum(case when r.purchase_kind = #{purchaseKind} then r.wechat_payment_amount else 0 end), 0) as g_cash, coalesce(sum(case when r.purchase_kind = #{purchaseKind} and (r.refund_deadline > #{asOf} or exists (select 1 from coop_complaint cc where cc.registration_id = r.id and cc.status < 3 and cc.del_flag = 0)) and exists (select 1 from registration_entitlement e where e.registration_id = r.id and e.status = 0) then greatest(r.wechat_payment_amount - coalesce(rr.refund_amount, 0), 0) else 0 end), 0) as u_out, coalesce(sum(case when r.purchase_kind = #{purchaseKind} and (r.refund_deadline > #{asOf} or exists (select 1 from coop_complaint cc where cc.registration_id = r.id and cc.status < 3 and cc.del_flag = 0)) and exists (select 1 from registration_entitlement e where e.registration_id = r.id and e.status = 0) then greatest(r.wechat_payment_amount - coalesce(rr.refund_amount, 0), 0) else 0 end), 0) as u_pending, coalesce(sum(case when r.purchase_kind = #{purchaseKind} then coalesce(rr.refund_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as r_refund, coalesce(sum(case when r.purchase_kind is null or r.purchase_kind <> #{purchaseKind} or r.wechat_payment_amount is null or r.refund_deadline is null or coalesce(rr.unknown_refund_count, 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as unknown_count, coalesce(sum(case when coalesce(rr.refund_amount, 0) > coalesce(r.wechat_payment_amount, 0) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as invalid_refund_count from cms_registration r join cms_activity a on r.owner_type = 2 and a.id = r.owner_id join cms_topic t on t.id = a.topic_id and t.product_type = #{productType} left join ( select source_id, sum(case when payout_status in (1, 3, 4) then refund_amount else 0 end) as refund_amount, sum(case when payout_status in (1, 3, 4) and refund_amount is null then 1 else 0 end) as unknown_refund_count from refund_application where source_type = 'registration' and (del_flag is null or del_flag <> 2) group by source_id ) rr on rr.source_id = r.id where a.topic_id = #{topicId} and r.payment_status = 2

select r.source_club_id, count(*) as ticket_count,
sum(case when greatest(r.wechat_payment_amount - coalesce(rr.refund_amount, 0), 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as net_ticket_count, coalesce(sum(greatest(r.wechat_payment_amount - coalesce(rr.refund_amount, 0), 0)), 0) as earned_amount, sum(case when r.source_frozen_at is null then 1 else 0 end) as unfrozen_count from cms_registration r join cms_activity a on r.owner_type = 2 and a.id = r.owner_id join cms_topic t on t.id = a.topic_id and t.product_type = #{productType} left join ( select source_id, sum(case when payout_status in (1, 3, 4) then refund_amount else 0 end) as refund_amount from refund_application where source_type = 'registration' and (del_flag is null or del_flag <> 2) group by source_id ) rr on rr.source_id = r.id where a.topic_id = #{topicId} and r.payment_status = 2 and r.purchase_kind = #{purchaseKind} group by r.source_club_id order by r.source_club_id is not null, r.source_club_id
select * from topic_edition_funds where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} limit 1

mapper.insert: insert into topic_edition_funds (topic_id, snapshot_kind, snapshot_version, is_current, n_cash, g_cash, u_in, g_earned, u_out, u_pending, r_refund, input_hash, idempotency_key, computed_by, computed_at) values (#{topicId}, #{snapshotKind}, #{version}, #{current}, #{nCash}, #{gCash}, #{uIn}, #{gEarned}, #{uOut}, #{uPending}, #{rRefund}, #{inputHash}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{computedBy}, #{computedAt})
